limits: Historical2022/23-2024/25 snapshots fetched2026-10-08 and used in earlier research; not a fresh unseen test or prospective claim.
Fixed365-day half-life and ridge.01; no parameter tuning, uncertainty intervals or reproduction of the original papers datasets/financial results.
Centered log strengths with extra intercept, ridge and bounded rate/rho coordinates are local adaptations, not the original unpenalized estimator.
The conservative rho envelope covers all fitted and neutral-unseen pairings; it can be narrower than per-observed-match feasibility.
One deterministic local optimizer initialization; convergence does not establish the global DC likelihood optimum.
Unseen teams use geometric-average neutral strength, not an independently established promoted-team quality estimate.

Parameters are fixed within each validation/holdout cohort; the XGBoost/L2 references use their existing rolling features and class-weight configurations. Comparisons describe those full configurations, not isolated model families.
External default XGBoost and L2 probabilities were frozen in run40481f7ebdfb8601, with identical match IDs/labels verified; they do not participate in this score-model selection.
No production model, live forecast or database record is replaced. Raw match IDs, fitted parameter arrays and individual predictions stay private.
